The risk is that L catches us if suspects drop to 1,000 or fewer at the end of any day, and the pool starts at 100,000, so I need to shrink it while being careful about what the kills reveal.

I'm weighing which kills to make on day one, with quick entries free only in the morning and afternoon, so I can take up to ten. Killing reveals death information that L can trace, but the traces only succeed where L can reach every place a victim was reported. I'm leaning toward the national-TV kill on days one to three since it reveals nothing, and building toward thirty kills within five days for the double multiplier.

I'm narrowing down the quick kills: the night worker and home routines stay in the pool, but day workers get ruled out if I take more than two kills in their busy morning and afternoon, which helps shrink L's options. I'm leaning toward taking ten quick kills in those blocks, though I still need to decide which ten.

I'm deciding to take all eleven kills on day one: ten quick ones split five in the morning and five in the afternoon, plus one timed kill of the national-TV victim, since L already knows the timed limit and that kill reveals nothing new. The quick kills need free blocks, so I'm placing them in morning and afternoon, with the timed one in the afternoon.
